SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = REPLACE(satscores.cds, '0', '')
WHERE satscores.rtype = 'D'
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.FRPM_Count_Ages_5_17
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (
    SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.[School Code] = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.rtype = 'D'
GROUP BY frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.[AvgScrRead]) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.`District Name` = 'SBE - The School of Arts and Enterprise'
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.`School Code` = satscores.cds
JOIN schools ON frpm.`School Code` = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`District Name` IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT dname
    FROM satscores
    WHERE dname IN (
        SELECT dname
        FROM satscores
        GROUP BY dname
        ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
AND schools.AgeGroup BETWEEN 5 AND 17;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.[School Name] = satscores.sname AND frpm.[District Name] = satscores.dname
WHERE frpm.[District Name] = 'SBE - The School of Arts and Enterprise'
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.[AvgScrRead]) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.[Charter School (Y/N)] = 1
GROUP BY frpm.[Charter School Number]
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
GROUP BY f.School
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead = (
    SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.`School Code` = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'D'
ORDER BY s.`AvgScrRead` DESC
LIMIT 1;
